content:
Thisversion is the one Gillian Welch and Dave Rawlings play in the BBC-4 sessions 
in St. Luke's in London.

Capo on the 5th fret

[tab][ch]Am[/ch]                                              [ch]G[/ch]
  Caleb Meyer he lived alone, In them hollerin pines [/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]                             [ch]D[/ch]                                       [ch]Am[/ch]
  And he made a little whiskey for himself said it helped to pass the time[/tab]
[tab]  [ch]Am[/ch]                                                  [ch]G[/ch]
  Long one evening in back of my house, Caleb come around[/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]                          [ch]D[/ch]                                 [ch]Am[/ch]
  And he called my name till I went out, With no-one else around[/tab]


[tab]  [ch]Am[/ch]                                                    [ch]G[/ch]
  Caleb Meyer your ghost is gonna wear them rattling chains [/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]                  [ch]D[/ch]                                  [ch]Am[/ch]
  But when I go to sleep at night, Don't you call my name[/tab]


[tab]  [ch]Am[/ch]                                                      [ch]G[/ch]
  Where's your husband Nellie Cane, Wheres your darlin' gone? [/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]                         [ch]D[/ch]                               [ch]Am[/ch]
  Did he go on down the mountainside, and leave you all alone?[/tab]
[tab]  [ch]Am[/ch]                                                             [ch]G[/ch]
  Yes my husband's gone to Bowling Green, to do some business there [/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]                       [ch]D[/ch]                                  [ch]Am[/ch]
  Then Caleb threw that bottle down, And grabbed me by my hair [/tab]


[tab]  [ch]Am[/ch]                                                    [ch]G[/ch]
  Caleb Meyer your ghost is gonna wear them rattling chains [/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]                  [ch]D[/ch]                                  [ch]Am[/ch]
  But when I go to sleep at night, Don't you call my name[/tab]


[tab]  [ch]Am[/ch]                                                  [ch]G[/ch]
  He threw me in the needle bed, Across my dress he lay  [/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]                    [ch]D[/ch]                                 [ch]Am[/ch]
  He pinned my hands above my head, And I commenced to pray[/tab]
[tab]  [ch]Am[/ch]                                                  [ch]G[/ch]
  I cried my God I am your child, Send your angels down[/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]                      [ch]D[/ch]                               [ch]Am[/ch]
  Then feeling with my finger tips, The bottle neck I found [/tab]
[tab]  [ch]Am[/ch]                                                [ch]G[/ch]
  I drew that glass across his neck, Fine as any blade  [/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]                           [ch]D[/ch]                                [ch]Am[/ch]
  Then I felt his blood pour fast and hot, Around me where I laid [/tab]
 

[tab]  [ch]Am[/ch]                                                    [ch]G[/ch]
  Caleb Meyer your ghost is gonna wear them rattling chains [/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]                  [ch]D[/ch]                                  [ch]Am[/ch]
  But when I go to sleep at night, Don't you call my name[/tab]

[tab]  [ch]Am[/ch]                                                    [ch]G[/ch]
  Caleb Meyer your ghost is gonna wear them rattling chains [/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]                  [ch]D[/ch]                                  [ch]Am[/ch]
  But when I go to sleep at night, Don't you call my name[/tab]



have fun playing the song!
